items.name: local-team-grid
items.title: Local Team Grid
items.description: Practitioner cards with illustrated portraits, years of experience, specialty chips and a booking link that lift on hover.

items.name: local-services-price-list
items.title: Local Services Price List
items.description: Services in columns with duration and price, a shimmering popular marker and a bold package offer underneath.

items.name: local-reservation-bar
items.title: Local Reservation Bar
items.description: A wide reservation bar with date, time and a guest stepper over a warm sunset street scene, with live availability dots around the chosen time.

items.name: local-before-after
items.title: Local Before and After
items.description: A draggable, keyboard accessible before and after slider with two illustrated kitchen scenes, caption chips and a strip of project results.

items.name: local-reviews-wall
items.title: Local Reviews Wall
items.description: A rating summary with a star distribution beside two columns of review cards that drift slowly in opposite directions and pause on hover.

items.name: comparison-tiers
items.title: Comparison Tiers
items.description: Plan cards side by side that list the same feature rows, so checks, dashes and values line up across tiers. The recommended plan gets a rotating beam border and a badge, and hovering a row highlights it in every card.

items.name: comparison-scorecard
items.title: Comparison Scorecard
items.description: An us versus them scorecard with two overall score rings and a list of benchmark metrics, each with paired bars that grow in and numbers that count up, plus a delta chip per row.

items.name: comparison-calculator
items.title: Comparison Calculator
items.description: A light pricing calculator where sliders for seats and contacts and a monthly or yearly switch update a bar chart of your price against competitors, with the yearly savings counting to the new value.

items.name: nav-tab-bar
items.title: Nav Tab Bar
items.description: A mobile bottom tab bar with a glowing blob that springs and squashes to the active tab, count and dot badges, and arrow key support. The preview shows it inside a phone whose screens slide with the selection.

items.name: nav-app-header
items.title: Nav App Header
items.description: A light app header with a workspace breadcrumb and live status, a search button with a Cmd K shortcut, notifications and an account menu, over a row of tabs with counts and a sliding underline.

items.name: nav-side-dock
items.title: Nav Side Dock
items.description: A vertical icon dock pinned to the side of an app. Icons swell as the pointer passes over them, a slow wave runs through the dock while idle, and tooltips, badges and an active indicator sit beside each icon.

items.name: showcase-bento-gallery
items.title: Showcase Bento Gallery
items.description: A bento grid of product screens that reveal with a staggered wipe. On hover or focus each screenshot zooms and a caption slides up with a short description and an arrow.

items.name: showcase-before-after
items.title: Showcase Before After
items.description: A light redesign showcase: a browser frame holds the old and new screen, split by a draggable divider that also works with arrow keys. It sweeps once on load to hint that it moves, with result stats underneath.

items.name: showcase-device-tabs
items.title: Showcase Device Tabs
items.description: A feature carousel with a list of tabs beside a large laptop. Each tab swaps the screen with a staggered build, and a progress line advances the tour on its own, pausing on hover or focus.

items.name: download-changelog
items.title: Download Changelog
items.description: A release section with the latest version card, highlights and download buttons per platform, next to a changelog timeline that draws in, with collapsible releases, typed notes and filters for new, improved and fixed.

items.name: download-requirements
items.title: Download Requirements
items.description: A light system requirements block with macOS, Windows and Linux tabs on a sliding pill. Each tab shows a minimum versus recommended table with meters, plus the installer, its checksum with copy, and other formats.

items.name: download-qr-handoff
items.title: Download QR Handoff
items.description: A continue on your phone card with a QR pattern built from the link, a scan line sweeping over it and a countdown that refreshes the code. A text me a link form and a phone preview of the session sit alongside.

items.name: contact-booking-calendar
items.title: Contact Booking Calendar
items.description: A light booking section: host card, a month calendar with open days, time slots that cascade in, then a validated details form with loading and confirmation states.

items.name: contact-chat-widget
items.title: Contact Chat Widget
items.description: A dark contact section with a support chat card: the greeting types in, quick replies stream an answer, and an inline email card validates, loads and confirms.

items.name: footer-newsletter-first
items.title: Footer Newsletter First
items.description: A paper toned footer led by a large newsletter signup with a light beam circling the email field, followed by a five column sitemap and a status bar.

items.name: footer-app-download
items.title: Footer App Download
items.description: An app footer with a promo card, generic platform download badges, a drawn QR code, a floating phone with a scrolling feed, link columns, a language select and a theme switch that recolors the footer.

items.name: cta-rotating-band
items.title: CTA Rotating Band
items.description: A full width band over a drifting gradient mesh with grain, a headline whose middle word rotates with a blur slide and an underline timer, and two buttons.

items.name: cta-sticky-dock
items.title: CTA Sticky Dock
items.description: A glass dock bar that springs up and sticks to the bottom of a framed page, shrinks while you scroll down, expands on the way up, and can be dismissed and restored.

items.name: faq-chat-thread
items.title: FAQ Chat Thread
items.description: FAQ as a conversation: questions become visitor bubbles and the answers type out with a cursor. A numbered question list sits beside the thread, chips replace it on narrow containers.

items.name: faq-flip-cards
items.title: FAQ Flip Cards
items.description: A white grid of question cards that flip in 3D to reveal the answer, with a reveal all toggle, an open counter and a hint wobble on the first card.

items.name: pricing-seats-slider
items.title: Pricing Seats Slider
items.description: Per seat pricing on paper: a team size slider with a filling crowd of dots, volume bands, and three plans whose totals roll digit by digit with a per seat breakdown.

items.name: pricing-feature-table
items.title: Pricing Feature Table
items.description: A dark comparison table with a sticky blurred header of plans and prices, collapsible feature groups, a monthly or yearly switch that flips the prices, and plan tabs on narrow containers.

items.name: stats-mosaic
items.title: Stats Mosaic
items.description: A by the numbers bento: counting figures in tiles that each carry a different animated mini visual, from a drawing area chart and uptime bars to a dot field, gauge, avatar marquee and star fill.

items.name: stats-before-after
items.title: Stats Before After
items.description: A light case study block that plays numbers from before to after, with a draggable timeline, Before and After buttons, delta pills whose arrows flip, comparison bars and a customer quote.

items.name: dashboard-crypto
items.title: Crypto Portfolio Dashboard
items.description: A portfolio screen with a scrolling price ticker, total balance with a sparkline, an allocation donut, a candlestick chart with volume and range tabs, recent activity and a sortable holdings table. Selecting an asset charts it.

items.name: dashboard-hr
items.title: HR People Dashboard
items.description: A light people operations screen on warm paper: headcount by team as stacked columns, a hiring pipeline funnel, a November time-off heatmap with day details, upcoming reviews and a team directory, all filtered by team.

items.name: dashboard-support
items.title: Customer Support Dashboard
items.description: A help desk overview with segmented KPI meters, ticket volume by hour against last week and a forecast, an SLA gauge with a target marker, a queue with priority pills, assignees and SLA countdowns, a CSAT trend and a live activity feed.

items.name: dashboard-marketing
items.title: Marketing Campaigns Dashboard
items.description: A campaign report with a KPI band, a sortable channel table with inline spend and ROAS bars, a flowing conversion funnel, budget burn rings with pacing, top regions and gradient creative thumbnails ranked by CTR.

items.name: notfound-maze
items.title: 404 Maze
items.description: A dark 404 section where a tiny pixel explorer wanders a grid maze looking for the exit. Point anywhere on the grid, or use the arrow keys, and it finds a path toward you.

items.name: notfound-letter
items.title: 404 Apology Letter
items.description: A light 404 page written as a typed letter on airmail paper. The apology types itself out, then a red 404 return to sender stamp thumps onto the sheet.

items.name: proof-case-studies
items.title: Case Study Cards
items.description: Three case study cards with a wordmark, an industry tag and one big result that counts up on scroll. Hovering a card lifts the number and slides the customer quote up from below.

items.name: proof-live-activity
items.title: Live Activity Proof
items.description: A light social proof section pairing a rating summary with a live feed of recent sign ups. New activity toasts slide in at the top every few seconds while older ones drift down and fade.

items.name: how-stepper-screens
items.title: Stepper With Screens
items.description: A how it works section with a vertical stepper beside a mock app window. Each step swaps the screen with a blur and slide, and the steps advance on their own with a progress bar.

items.name: how-dashed-path
items.title: Dashed Path Steps
items.description: Four numbered cards on paper, joined by a marching dashed route. A dot travels the path and each card lights up as the dot reaches it; on narrow screens the route turns vertical.

items.name: blog-newsletter-issues
items.title: Newsletter Issue List
items.description: A newsletter archive section: numbered issues with date, topics and reading time that reveal an excerpt on hover, beside a subscribe card with a rotating border and email validation.

items.name: blog-category-tiles
items.title: Blog Category Tiles
items.description: A light blog index with six topic tiles, each with its own color, floating shape and post count, followed by a dark featured post strip with a zooming cover.

items.name: shop-reviews
items.title: Product Reviews
items.description: A light product reviews section with an average score, a clickable rating histogram, a recommend ring, filter chips and review cards with verified badges and helpful votes.

items.name: shop-category-mosaic
items.title: Category Mosaic
items.description: A mosaic of shop categories with gradient scenes and product silhouettes. Tiles wipe in on scroll and zoom their image on hover while an arrow and tagline slide in.

items.name: shop-order-tracking
items.title: Order Tracking
items.description: An order status section with a stylized city map where a courier van drives the route to a pulsing pin, an ETA card, a delivery timeline and the items in the parcel.

items.name: app-settings-page
items.title: App Settings Page
items.description: An account settings screen with vertical tabs for profile, notifications, security and billing. A save bar slides up as soon as anything changes.

items.name: app-notifications-center
items.title: App Notifications Center
items.description: A full notifications inbox with All, Mentions and Unread filters, day groups, mark as read, a snooze menu with undo, an empty state and a detail pane.

items.name: app-calendar-month
items.title: App Calendar Month
items.description: A month calendar with colored event chips, a highlighted today, an event popover, sliding month changes and an agenda panel for the selected day.

items.name: app-file-manager
items.title: App File Manager
items.description: A file browser with breadcrumbs, grid and list views, checkbox selection with a bulk action bar, a storage meter and a drag-over upload overlay.

items.name: app-chat-inbox
items.title: App Chat Inbox
items.description: A team chat screen with channels and direct messages, grouped bubbles with day dividers, a composer with attachment chips and a live typing indicator.

items.name: app-profile-editor
items.title: App Profile Editor
items.description: A portfolio profile editor with a live preview card beside the form, a photo upload, link rows you can add and remove, skill chips and a card color picker.

items.name: app-onboarding-checklist
items.title: App Onboarding Checklist
items.description: A light getting-started screen with a progress ring, expandable checklist steps, a confetti burst when everything is done, plus Skip for now and dismiss.

items.name: sidebar-mail-folders
items.title: Sidebar Mail Folders
items.description: A mail app sidebar with a compose button, folders with unread counts, colored labels and a storage meter that fills on mount.

items.name: sidebar-chat-channels
items.title: Sidebar Chat Channels
items.description: A team chat sidebar with channels and direct messages in two collapsible sections, presence dots and bold unread rows.

items.name: sidebar-icon-labels
items.title: Sidebar Icon Labels
items.description: A narrow icon rail that expands on hover or focus into a labeled sidebar floating over the content, with a sliding active indicator.

items.name: sidebar-sections-accordion
items.title: Sidebar Sections Accordion
items.description: Grouped sidebar sections that expand with animated height, stagger their items in and can remember which ones were open.

items.name: sidebar-settings-nav
items.title: Sidebar Settings Nav
items.description: A settings sidebar with a back link, grouped items and a search field that filters items live and highlights the match.

items.name: list-timeline-vertical
items.title: List Timeline Vertical
items.description: A vertical timeline of events with icon nodes, a connecting line that draws in, relative timestamps and expandable details.

items.name: list-notifications-grouped
items.title: List Notifications Grouped
items.description: Notifications grouped by day with unread dots, a mark all as read button and hover actions to toggle read or dismiss a row.

items.name: list-pinned-reorder
items.title: List Pinned Reorder
items.description: A list where items pin to the top and move up or down with buttons or Alt and arrow keys, animated with a FLIP transition.

items.name: list-expandable-rows
items.title: List Expandable Rows
items.description: Rows that open in place to reveal details with a smooth height transition, one at a time or several at once.

items.name: agent-trace-timeline
items.title: Agent Trace Timeline
items.description: A vertical trace of an agent run. Each span shows a status icon, a nested name and a bar sized to its start and duration, and spans with a payload expand in place.

items.name: agent-approval-card
items.title: Agent Approval Card
items.description: A human-in-the-loop card for a proposed agent action, with a before and after summary, an Approve step that asks for confirmation, inline editing and a countdown that rejects on its own.

items.name: agent-memory-panel
items.title: Agent Memory Panel
items.description: A list of facts the agent remembers, each with a source chip and a confidence meter. Facts can be edited in place or forgotten with an animated removal.

items.name: agent-model-picker
items.title: Agent Model Picker
items.description: A model selector with capability tags and speed and cost meters. It follows the listbox pattern with arrow keys, Home, End, typeahead and Escape.

items.name: agent-file-diff
items.title: Agent File Diff
items.description: A compact unified diff viewer with line numbers, hunk headers, added and removed lines, collapsible unchanged context and a button that copies the patch.

items.name: agent-composer-attachments
items.title: Agent Composer with Attachments
items.description: A message composer with animated attachment chips, a slash-command menu that opens on "/" and a send button with idle, ready, sending and sent states.

items.name: site-toc-scrollspy
items.title: Table of Contents Scrollspy
items.description: A sticky table of contents whose active item follows the page as you scroll, marked by an indicator that slides between entries. Clicking an entry scrolls to its section.

items.name: site-promo-modal
items.title: Promo Modal
items.description: A promotional popup with a gradient artwork side, a delayed entrance and a don't-show-again checkbox. It closes with Escape or a click on the backdrop, and renders inside its own relative frame.

items.name: site-hotspot-tour
items.title: Hotspot Tour
items.description: A product tour made of pulsing hotspots laid over a mock interface, with a step popover that offers Next, Back and Skip and works with the arrow keys.

items.name: site-announcement-ticker
items.title: Announcement Ticker
items.description: A thin announcement bar that rotates several messages vertically, with a progress hairline, a counter, pause on hover and focus, and a dismiss button.

items.name: about-team-filter
items.title: About Team Filter
items.description: A team grid with filter chips per team. Hovering or focusing a card lifts the avatar and slides up a bio panel with location, and cards stagger back in whenever the filter changes.

items.name: about-timeline-scroll
items.title: About Timeline Scroll
items.description: A light, horizontal company timeline with snap scrolling. A year rail above fills as you scroll, the active year lights up, and arrow buttons, year markers and the keyboard all move between milestones.

items.name: about-mission-split
items.title: About Mission Split
items.description: A huge mission statement on the left that reveals word by word with highlighted words, and three numbered principle cards on the right whose metrics count up when they scroll into view.

items.name: about-press-wall
items.title: About Press Wall
items.description: A white press section with two marquee rows of typographic wordmark chips moving in opposite directions, a rotating serif press quote with progress dots, a row of award cards with laurels and a press kit link.

items.name: waitlist-inline-pill
items.title: Waitlist Inline Pill
items.description: A minimal dark waitlist with one inline email field over a breathing halo. Invalid input shakes the field, the button shows a spinner while saving, and the form morphs into a success pill with a drawn check.

items.name: waitlist-referral-board
items.title: Waitlist Referral Board
items.description: A referral waitlist with a name and email form, reward tiers and a live leaderboard of top referrers with animated bars. After joining, your spot counts up, a referral link appears with a copy button and you join the board.

items.name: waitlist-teaser-unlock
items.title: Waitlist Teaser Unlock
items.description: A light split waitlist with a blurred product preview behind a lock badge and a scanning shimmer. Joining with email and team size sharpens the preview into focus and swaps the form for a confirmation.

items.name: waitlist-capacity-countdown
items.title: Waitlist Capacity Countdown
items.description: A dark launch panel with a rolling four-unit countdown, a striped capacity bar that fills toward the seat limit, a spots-left counter that ticks as people join and an email form that reserves a numbered seat.

items.name: profile-settings-card
items.title: Profile Settings Card
items.description: A light settings page with a section nav and a profile card: avatar color swatches tint the cover, fields validate inline, edited fields get a dot, and a footer tracks unsaved changes with reset, saving and saved states.

items.name: profile-team-presence
items.title: Profile Team Presence
items.description: A grid of teammate cards with presence dots that pulse when online, status notes, a typing indicator, local times and message and call actions, filtered by a status switch and a search field.

items.name: profile-resume-timeline
items.title: Profile Resume Timeline
items.description: A resume profile with a sticky card holding the person, availability, summary and animated skill bars, beside an experience timeline whose line draws down and whose current role pulses, plus education.

items.name: loader-gears
items.title: Loader Gears
items.description: Three toothed gears mesh and turn in opposite directions, each at the right speed for its tooth count.

items.name: loader-hourglass
items.title: Loader Hourglass
items.description: An hourglass whose sand drains through the neck, then flips over and refills for the next round.

items.name: loader-dna-helix
items.title: Loader DNA Helix
items.description: A double helix of dots twists in sine motion, with depth shading and rungs that stretch between the strands.

items.name: loader-battery-fill
items.title: Loader Battery Fill
items.description: A battery icon fills with segments, pulses when full and starts over. Pass a value to show a fixed charge level instead.

items.name: loader-signal-bars
items.title: Loader Signal Bars
items.description: Signal bars of growing height light up one after another, like a device searching for a connection.

items.name: loader-book-flip
items.title: Loader Book Flip
items.description: An open book whose pages turn one after another in 3D, then return to the right-hand stack.

items.name: loader-bouncing-balls
items.title: Loader Bouncing Balls
items.description: Three balls of different colors bounce out of phase, squashing on impact above a soft ground shadow.

items.name: loader-rocket-trail
items.title: Loader Rocket Trail
items.description: A small rocket accelerates along a curved path and leaves a trail that fades behind it, then launches again.

items.name: button-ink-ripple
items.title: Button Ink Ripple
items.description: A button whose click ripple spreads from the exact pointer position and takes its ink color from the variant. Keyboard activation ripples from the center.

items.name: button-border-spin
items.title: Button Border Spin
items.description: A pill button with a conic gradient comet orbiting its edge around a solid inner face. The border spins all the time or only on hover.

items.name: button-icon-slide-expand
items.title: Button Icon Slide Expand
items.description: A round icon button that grows to reveal its label on hover or focus. The width animates, so neighboring items in a flex row glide aside.

items.name: button-split-halves
items.title: Button Split Halves
items.description: The label is cut in two and the halves slide apart on hover, uncovering an alternate label or icon underneath.

items.name: button-countdown-confirm
items.title: Button Countdown Confirm
items.description: A destructive button that arms on the first press, drains a countdown ring next to a Cancel button and confirms on its own at zero.

items.name: button-tilt-glare
items.title: Button Tilt Glare
items.description: A chunky 3D button that tilts toward the pointer with a moving glare and a shadow that shifts opposite the tilt. It sways on its own until touched.

items.name: button-underline-grow
items.title: Button Underline Grow
items.description: A text link or button whose underline grows from the center while an arrow nudges forward. After it is used, the text shifts to a visited color.

items.name: button-bubbles-pop
items.title: Button Bubbles Pop
items.description: A button that squashes on press, rebounds and releases a handful of bubbles that float up and pop. The scatter is deterministic.

items.name: gallery-showcase
items.title: Gallery Showcase
items.description: A large featured image above a row of thumbnails. Picking a thumbnail crossfades the feature with a slow settle, slides the caption in and restarts the autoplay progress.

items.name: gallery-archive
items.title: Gallery Archive
items.description: A typographic archive index of year, title and type. Hovering or focusing an entry dims the other rows and shows a floating image preview that trails the pointer.

items.name: gallery-backstage
items.title: Gallery Backstage
items.description: A dark stage with the images standing in a row. A soft spotlight cone picks out the active one while the rest wait dimmed behind; drag across the stage, click or use the arrows to move the light.

items.name: gallery-grid-expand
items.title: Gallery Grid Expand
items.description: A grid of image cards. Opening a card grows it from its own spot to fill the grid with the title and caption; Back or Escape shrinks it back into place.

items.name: gallery-coverflow
items.title: Gallery Coverflow
items.description: A classic cover flow: the center image faces you while the others turn away in 3D and stack to each side, with a soft reflection on the floor. Drag, click a side image or use the arrow keys.

items.name: gallery-filmstrip
items.title: Gallery Filmstrip
items.description: A strip of film with sprocket holes and edge numbers drifts under a center gate, and the frame in the gate is projected large in the viewer above.

items.name: gallery-rail-hang
items.title: Gallery Rail Hang
items.description: Prints hang from a clothes rail on small hangers and swing like pendulums when the pointer brushes past or the rail is dragged. Clicking one pulls it forward.

items.name: gallery-coverflow-lights
items.title: Gallery Coverflow Lights
items.description: A cover flow where the active image throws soft colored light onto the stage while the neighbors turn away into the dark.

items.name: gallery-scatter
items.title: Gallery Scatter
items.description: Polaroid-style prints lie scattered at loose angles. Drag any of them to the top of the pile, or tidy the whole table into a neat grid.

items.name: gallery-runway
items.title: Gallery Runway
items.description: Framed images walk toward the viewer along a lit runway in 3D, growing and stepping aside as they pass. Hovering a frame stops the flow.

items.name: carousel-lightbox
items.title: Carousel Lightbox
items.description: A thumbnail strip where each image opens in a lightbox. The picture zooms out of its thumbnail and flies back on close, with previous and next, Escape and a focus trap.

items.name: carousel-page-count
items.title: Carousel Page Count
items.description: A swipeable carousel with a rolling two-digit page counter, a progress hairline and arrow buttons that disable at both ends.

items.name: carousel-scrubber
items.title: Carousel Scrubber
items.description: A card carousel with a draggable scrubber under it. Dragging moves the track continuously and releases onto the nearest stop. Arrow keys step between stops.

items.name: card-stack-expand
items.title: Card Stack Expand
items.description: Notification cards stacked with depth. Hover, focus or the Expand button spreads them into a list, and each card dismisses with a swipe or its close button. New cards drop in from the top.

items.name: menu-context
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click and long-press menu that opens at the pointer and flips at the edges. It has icons, shortcuts, a submenu, a danger item and full keyboard control.

items.name: list-todo-animated
items.title: Animated Todo List
items.description: A task list with an add field, a check mark that draws itself, a strike-through that sweeps across the text, collapsing delete and up and down reordering that glides into place.

items.name: modal-shared-layout
items.title: Shared Layout Modal
items.description: Cards that grow into a modal and shrink back into the same spot. The card morphs by measuring its box, the content crossfades, and everything stays inside its own frame.

items.name: view-direction-switch
items.title: Direction Switch
items.description: Switches between views with tabs or steps. Moving forward slides content to the left, moving back slides it to the right, and the container height eases to the new view.

items.name: footer-reveal-under
items.title: Footer Reveal Under
items.description: A footer that sits beneath the page and is uncovered as the content above scrolls away, with a gradient wordmark that follows the pointer, link columns and a newsletter field. Wrap the page above it in FooterRevealUnderPage so it covers the footer.

items.name: scroll-image-reveal
items.title: Scroll Image Reveal
items.description: An image that opens from a thin glowing slit to full size when it scrolls into view, while it settles from a 1.3x zoom and its caption slides up line by line.

items.name: cursor-magnetic-filings
items.title: Cursor Magnetic Filings
items.description: A canvas field of iron-filing needles that swing into the field lines of a dipole magnet. A hidden magnet drifts on its own until the pointer takes over.

items.name: cursor-trail-velocity
items.title: Cursor Trail Velocity
items.description: A canvas cursor trail that reads pointer speed: slow moves leave small round dots, fast flicks stretch into long thin streaks that shift in hue.

items.name: chart-line-graph
items.title: Chart Line Graph
items.description: A responsive line graph that draws its path when it scrolls into view, with gradient area fill, gridlines, a pulsing end point and a crosshair tooltip you can drive with the pointer or the arrow keys.

items.name: hero-stagger-intro
items.title: Hero Stagger Intro
items.description: A hero section whose eyebrow, headline lines, subtitle, buttons and product visual enter one after another with a rise, blur and fade. Change the replay key to play it again.

items.name: curtain-blinds
items.title: Curtain Blinds
items.description: Venetian blind slats that tilt open one after another in 3D to reveal the content, and tilt shut in reverse order.

items.name: curtain-clip-wipe
items.title: Curtain Clip Wipe
items.description: A crisp clip-path wipe that pulls the curtain away with a bright leading edge and a soft trailing glow, in five directions.

items.name: curtain-doors
items.title: Curtain Doors
items.description: Two doors swing open from the center in 3D with shading that deepens as they turn, while the room behind brightens into view.

items.name: curtain-mixed
items.title: Curtain Mixed
items.description: A mosaic of tiles that wipe away row by row, each row in the opposite direction of the one before, in a snaking order.

items.name: curtain-iris
items.title: Curtain Iris
items.description: A scope-style iris that opens a circle from a chosen point, with a bright ring at its edge. In pointer mode a click picks the point.

items.name: curtain-stagger-wipe
items.title: Curtain Stagger Wipe
items.description: Vertical bars sweep off one after another, each trailed by a colored layer, then drop back in reverse to cover the content.

items.name: curtain-wipe
items.title: Curtain Wipe
items.description: One soft curtain that glides away with a glowing gradient edge, feathering wider as it travels across.

items.name: text-scramble-view
items.title: Text Scramble View
items.description: Text that churns through random glyphs and settles left to right when it scrolls into view. Click or press Enter to replay it.

items.name: text-scramble-center
items.title: Text Scramble Center
items.description: Scrambled text that locks in from the middle outward. Each letter flares with a soft glow the moment it resolves.

items.name: typewriter-human
items.title: Typewriter Human
items.description: A typewriter with uneven rhythm: longer beats after punctuation, the occasional wrong key noticed late and backspaced. The sequence is seeded, so it is identical on every render.

items.name: typewriter-swap
items.title: Typewriter Swap
items.description: Types a phrase, holds it, then deletes only what differs before typing the next one. A shared opening stays on screen and is dimmed while the rest is erased.

items.name: ticker-vertical
items.title: Ticker Vertical
items.description: A news ticker that scrolls upward in a loop. The row passing through the middle lights up, the edges fade out, and hover or focus pauses it. Two columns scroll in opposite directions.

items.name: loader-fill-text
items.title: Loader Fill Text
items.description: An outlined word that fills with color from the bottom up behind a rolling wave surface. Drive it with a value or let it loop.

items.name: loader-line-reveal
items.title: Loader Line Reveal
items.description: Thin lines draw across one after another, and the title and placeholder bars beneath each line wipe in behind it as loading completes.

items.name: loader-jumping-dots
items.title: Loader Jumping Dots
items.description: Three dots hop in turn, squashing when they land and stretching in the air, with a shadow on the ground that shrinks as they rise.

items.name: loader-dots-pulse
items.title: Loader Dots Pulse
items.description: Three dots swell and brighten one after another, with an optional text label in front, for inline waiting states.

items.name: hero-dot-globe
items.title: Hero Dot Globe
items.description: A pure black hero with a huge canvas sphere of thousands of tiny dots that spins on a tilted axis, leans toward the pointer and carries a bright belt drifting the other way. Sparse mono details frame a bottom-aligned headline and an install command.

items.name: bg-ferrofluid
items.title: Ferrofluid
items.description: A dark, glossy liquid-metal pool whose blobs rise toward the pointer and grow a crown of magnetic spikes, shaded with specular highlights.

items.name: bg-soft-aurora
items.title: Soft Aurora
items.description: Wide pastel aurora curtains that drift slowly, with a gentle bloom that follows the pointer and tiny motes floating upward.

items.name: bg-rune-rings
items.title: Rune Rings
items.description: Concentric glowing rings carrying orbiting glyph marks, each ring spinning at its own speed. The pointer tilts the whole system in 3D.

items.name: bg-grid-scan
items.title: Grid Scan
items.description: A flat grid crossed by a horizontal and a vertical scan line. The cell under the pointer lights up and leaves a trail of fading cells.

items.name: bg-color-bends
items.title: Color Bends
items.description: Saturated ribbons of color that flow across the area, twisting as they go and bending around a warp field that follows the pointer.

items.name: bg-prism-burst
items.title: Prism Burst
items.description: A slowly rotating burst of light rays that split into spectrum colors from a bright core that follows the pointer.

items.name: bg-faulty-terminal
items.title: Faulty Terminal
items.description: A wall of scrolling terminal output that tears, glitches and flickers now and then. Glyphs near the pointer brighten and scramble.

items.name: gallery-infinite-spiral
items.title: Gallery Infinite Spiral
items.description: Images laid out along a spiral that drifts forever, growing and brightening as they leave the center. Drag, scroll or use the arrow keys to move along it.

items.name: carousel-depth
items.title: Carousel Depth
items.description: A carousel in perspective: the active card is large and sharp while its neighbors turn away, shrink and dim. Supports drag, arrows, dots, keyboard and autoplay that pauses on hover.

items.name: wheel-option-picker
items.title: Wheel Option Picker
items.description: A vertical drum picker. Options sit on a cylinder in perspective and snap to the center after a drag, flick, wheel step or key press. Set the text size with style or className on the picker.

items.name: menu-staggered
items.title: Menu Staggered
items.description: A full-frame menu that slides in as three layered panels, then reveals its links one by one. The hamburger morphs into a close icon, Escape closes it and focus stays inside.

items.name: nav-card-expand
items.title: Nav Card Expand
items.description: A compact top bar that unfolds downward into a card with three link cards and a call to action. The panel floats over the page, so nothing below it moves.

items.name: bg-wave-pattern
items.title: Wave Pattern
items.description: A tiled pattern of stripes, checks or diamonds warped by travelling sine waves. Cells near the pointer lean toward it and pick up the accent color.

items.name: bg-slats
items.title: Slats
items.description: Rows of thin vertical slats that turn and catch the light in a rolling wave. A bright crest follows the pointer across them.

items.name: bg-ghost-fibers
items.title: Ghost Fibers
items.description: Translucent strands that drift on smooth noise and leave faint trails behind them. Strands thicken and glow where the pointer passes.

items.name: bg-crt-warp
items.title: CRT Warp
items.description: An old tube screen: curved frame, scanlines, color fringing, flicker and a rolling bar. The pointer pushes a lens of distortion across the glass. Shows an animated test pattern when it has no children.

items.name: bg-acid-squares
items.title: Acid Squares
items.description: A grid of squares that flash neon colors in rings spreading out from the pointer. Pulses fire on their own while nobody is touching it, and a click sends a bigger wave.

items.name: bg-scanner-sweep
items.title: Scanner Sweep
items.description: A beam sweeps back and forth over a grid of dots, lighting cells as it passes and marking a few as detected. The pointer takes hold of the beam.

items.name: bg-web-threads
items.title: Web Threads
items.description: A spider web strung to the edges with a knot in the middle. Moving the pointer across a thread plucks it, and the vibration travels through the web before it settles.

items.name: ball-crystal
items.title: Crystal Ball
items.description: A faceted low-poly sphere drawn on canvas. It turns slowly, tilts toward the pointer and moves its highlights with it.

items.name: edge-gradual-blur
items.title: Edge Gradual Blur
items.description: An overlay for the edge of a container that blurs the content under it a little more with every pixel, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers.

items.name: logo-loop-belt
items.title: Logo Loop Belt
items.description: An endless belt of wordmark chips with faded edges. It slows down or stops on hover and can run a second row in the opposite direction.

items.name: border-star-orbit
items.title: Border Star Orbit
items.description: A card whose border carries a glowing four-point star that circles the perimeter, dragging a trail of fading color behind it.

items.name: radio-jelly
items.title: Jelly Radio
items.description: A radio group whose selected dot squashes and stretches like jelly when it is chosen, while the label slides over. Arrow keys work out of the box.

items.name: checkbox-spring
items.title: Spring Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose box springs past its size when checked while the tick draws itself and bounces in. Supports a label and an indeterminate state.

items.name: micro-status-mark
items.title: Status Mark
items.description: A small status indicator whose outline morphs between a circle, a triangle and a rounded square as it changes between idle, loading, success, warning and error.

items.name: tooltip-warm
items.title: Warm Tooltip
items.description: A cream tooltip with a soft amber glow that springs out of its trigger with a small arrow wobble. Opens after a delay on hover and at once on keyboard focus.

items.name: menu-branched
items.title: Branched Menu
items.description: A tree menu whose submenus branch out with connector lines that draw in one after another. Arrow keys, Enter and Escape work at every level.

items.name: micro-code-slots
items.title: Code Slots
items.description: A code or PIN display where every character is a vertical reel that spins and settles on its value, with a short glow when each reel locks. Changing the value replays it.

items.name: select-glide
items.title: Glide Select
items.description: A custom select whose highlight glides between options on a spring and whose arrow rotates open. Supports arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Escape and type-ahead.

items.name: micro-slide-commit
items.title: Slide Commit
items.description: A press-and-slide control for destructive actions. The track turns from neutral to danger as the handle moves and locks with a pop when it reaches the end. Hold Enter does the same from the keyboard.

items.name: text-tech-readout
items.title: Tech Readout
items.description: Text that appears like an instrument readout: letters flip through glyphs before settling, corner brackets and a tick scale draw in, and small mono labels fade up around it.

items.name: text-echo
items.title: Text Echo
items.description: Text with trailing echo copies that stagger in, fade out with distance and breathe slowly. Hover or focus spreads them apart.

items.name: text-depth-layers
items.title: Depth Layers
items.description: Text built from many stacked layers that shift with the pointer for real parallax depth, with a shadow stack for volume. It drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

items.name: text-fold
items.title: Text Fold
items.description: Lines of text that fold open like paper with a per-line rotateX and perspective when they scroll into view, then pleat into an accordion on hover and unfold again when you leave.

items.name: button-specular
items.title: Specular Button
items.description: A metallic, glass or blue button with a specular highlight that slides across its surface, a lit edge bevel and a subtle tilt that follow the pointer. A scripted highlight plays until the pointer arrives.

items.name: card-border-glow
items.title: Card Border Glow
items.description: A card whose border lights up in the segment nearest the pointer, with a soft bloom spilling both outside and inside. While idle the glow slowly circles the border.

items.name: bento-pointer-glow
items.title: Bento Pointer Glow
items.description: A three-column bento grid where one cursor-following glow lights every tile border and surface. Tiles lift on hover or focus and swap their description for a secondary caption; built-in visuals animate on their own.

items.name: nav-gooey
items.title: Gooey Nav
items.description: A pill navigation whose active indicator is a gooey blob. Three blobs with different timings stretch and merge through an SVG filter as the selection moves. Arrow keys, Home and End change the selection.

items.name: slider-elastic
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: A slider whose track bends toward the pointer like a rubber band while you drag and springs back on release. The thumb rides the curve with a value bubble above it. Arrow keys, Page keys, Home and End also work.

items.name: bg-galaxy
items.title: Galaxy
items.description: A tilted spiral galaxy of thousands of twinkling stars with a warm core and dark dust lanes, turning slowly. The pointer shifts the depth layers and parts the stars around it.

items.name: bg-dark-veil
items.title: Dark Veil
items.description: A dark translucent veil of drifting smoke with faint colored light at its edges. The pointer lifts a ragged, glowing tear in it that stretches as it moves.

items.name: bg-silk-threads
items.title: Silk Threads
items.description: Dozens of long, thin threads flowing across the area in offset waves, with a highlight that slides along each one. The pointer combs through them and pushes them apart.

items.name: bg-layered-waves
items.title: Layered Waves
items.description: Stacked translucent waves in depth with gradient fills and soft crest lines, rolling gently. The wave closest to the pointer rises toward it.

items.name: bg-grid-motion
items.title: Grid Motion
items.description: A tilted wall of gradient tiles with small charts and cards, its rows sliding in alternating directions. Rows under the pointer speed up and brighten.

items.name: text-shuffle-in
items.title: Text Shuffle In
items.description: Every letter slides through a few other letters before it lands on its own. Plays when the text enters the viewport and again on hover or focus.

items.name: text-scroll-float
items.title: Text Scroll Float
items.description: Lines of text whose letters float up into place in a wave as the element scrolls into view. Progress follows the scroll position.

items.name: text-scroll-words
items.title: Text Scroll Words
items.description: A paragraph that wakes up word by word, from dim and blurred to bright and sharp, as it scrolls through the viewport.

items.name: text-circular
items.title: Text Circular
items.description: Text set around a circle that turns slowly. Hovering speeds it up and spins it the other way. The center takes any content.

items.name: text-ascii-render
items.title: Text ASCII Render
items.description: Turns text into a field of monospace characters on a canvas. The letters ripple on their own and light up around the pointer.

items.name: micro-sling-button
items.title: Sling Button
items.description: Drag the button back against a stretching band and let go. It slings forward, overshoots and settles on a spring.

items.name: micro-dodge-field
items.title: Dodge Field
items.description: A text field with a glowing dot that slips away from the pointer on a spring and tucks into the corner on focus. The input underneath is a plain accessible input.

items.name: micro-swipe-toast
items.title: Swipe Toast
items.description: A toast you flick sideways to dismiss. It resists with a rubber band, flies off past a threshold and carries an undo chip. Escape and the arrow keys dismiss it too.

items.name: micro-swipe-row
items.title: Swipe Row
items.description: A list row that reveals Archive on a swipe right and Delete on a swipe left. It snaps open or closed with momentum, and the arrow keys reveal the same actions.

items.name: micro-squish-switch
items.title: Squish Switch
items.description: A switch whose knob behaves like jelly. It squashes under the press, stretches in the direction of travel and wobbles into place, and it also follows a drag or a flick.

items.name: micro-wake-slider
items.title: Wake Slider
items.description: A slider whose thumb drags a stretching wake of liquid behind it and sends out ripples where it comes to rest. Arrow keys, Home, End and Page keys all work.

items.name: micro-rubber-segment
items.title: Rubber Segment
items.description: A segmented control whose selection pill stretches like rubber toward the new option, leading with one edge and letting the other catch up. Dragging across segments works too.

items.name: micro-pulse-heart
items.title: Pulse Heart
items.description: A heart toggle that beats twice in a loop while hovered or focused and fills with a burst of rings and sparks when pressed.

items.name: micro-bell-toggle
items.title: Bell Toggle
items.description: A notifications bell that swings on a decaying spring with a lagging clapper. Turning it on rings it and pops a badge dot; turning it off settles it quietly.

items.name: micro-comet-dial
items.title: Comet Dial
items.description: A rotary dial you flick. It spins with inertia, clicks into detents while the readout snaps to each one, and a comet tail follows the pointer around the rim.

items.name: checkout-one-page
items.title: Checkout One Page
items.description: Contact, shipping, delivery and payment on a single page beside a sticky order summary. Card numbers format as you type and pass a Luhn check, a progress rail fills as each part becomes valid, and a success state replaces the form.

items.name: checkout-split-summary
items.title: Checkout Split Summary
items.description: A dark two-column checkout with a brand panel on the left holding the order, a promotion code field and trust badges, and a card form on the right. The total counts to its new value when a code is applied.

items.name: checkout-stepper-card
items.title: Checkout Stepper Card
items.description: One centered card that walks through Details, Payment and Confirm with a glowing progress track. Steps slide in from the direction you travel, each step validates before moving on, and the review step links back to edit.

items.name: checkout-mobile-sheet
items.title: Checkout Mobile Sheet
items.description: A phone mockup with a product page and a wallet-style payment sheet that rises from the bottom. Payment is confirmed by dragging a slider, or with the arrow keys and Enter, followed by a success state inside the sheet.

items.name: checkout-subscription-upgrade
items.title: Checkout Subscription Upgrade
items.description: A light plan upgrade screen comparing the current plan with the new one. A seat slider drives a proration breakdown whose figures count to their new values, next to the card on file and a confirm button.

items.name: checkout-success-receipt
items.title: Checkout Success Receipt
items.description: An order confirmation with a self-drawing success mark, a paper receipt that prints out of a slot with perforated edges and a barcode, and a delivery timeline. Download receipt saves a text file locally unless you handle it.

items.name: checkout-payment-failed
items.title: Checkout Payment Failed
items.description: A declined payment screen that explains the reason and offers three ways forward: retry the same card, enter another card, or pay by bank transfer with copyable sample details. A support card sits alongside with the order reference.

items.name: checkout-billing-settings
items.title: Checkout Billing Settings
items.description: A light billing settings page with the current plan, saved payment methods that can be made default or removed after an inline confirm, billing email and tax ID fields with format checks, usage meters and the next invoice.

items.name: checkout-invoice-history
items.title: Checkout Invoice History
items.description: Invoice history with counting totals, an upcoming invoice card, status filters, search and a year select over a table with status pills and download buttons. The table turns into stacked rows in narrow containers and exports to CSV locally.

items.name: checkout-pricing-modal
items.title: Checkout Pricing Modal
items.description: Plan cards inside a dialog over a dimmed app, with a monthly and yearly switch, prices that roll on change and a summary bar with Continue. Focus is trapped while open, Escape and the backdrop close it, and focus returns to the Upgrade button.

items.name: like-heart-fill
items.title: Like Heart Fill
items.description: A heart button that fills with a rolling liquid wave, pulses two rings and rolls its count to the new value.

items.name: like-thumbs-pop
items.title: Like Thumbs Pop
items.description: A thumbs-up that tilts back, pops forward and throws a fan of spark lines, with a rolling like count beside it.

items.name: like-reaction-picker
items.title: Like Reaction Picker
items.description: A react button that opens a row of five face reactions on click or press and hold. The hovered face scales up and the choice replaces the button label.

items.name: like-star-favorite
items.title: Like Star Favorite
items.description: A star toggle that spins, sprays a burst of tiny stars and shows an Added to favorites chip that fades on its own.

items.name: like-bookmark
items.title: Like Bookmark
items.description: A bookmark ribbon that drops into a tray with a bounce and a squash, next to a rolling saved counter.

items.name: follow-button
items.title: Follow Button
items.description: A pill that morphs its width between Follow, Following and Unfollow on hover, with a check that draws itself.

items.name: vote-arrows
items.title: Vote Arrows
items.description: An up and down vote pair with a rolling score, one active vote at a time and optimistic updates that roll back when onVote rejects.

items.name: share-popover
items.title: Share Popover
items.description: A share button that opens an anchored popover with a link field, a copy button that confirms and four generic channels. Escape and outside click close it.

items.name: share-sheet
items.title: Share Sheet
items.description: A bottom sheet with a scrim, a drag handle, a channel grid and a copy link row. It lives in its own frame, closes on drag down, scrim click or Escape.

items.name: share-floating-rail
items.title: Share Floating Rail
items.description: A round share trigger that fans a vertical rail of icon buttons out with a staggered spring. Each button shows a tooltip on hover or focus.

items.name: pay-card-preview
items.title: Pay Card Preview
items.description: A payment card that shows live number, name and expiry, and flips in 3D to the back when the CVC field is focused.

items.name: pay-card-form
items.title: Pay Card Form
items.description: A card entry form with grouped number formatting, a Luhn check, brand detection, expiry validation and a live card preview. It never sends data anywhere.

items.name: pay-method-picker
items.title: Pay Method Picker
items.description: A radio list of payment methods with a highlight that slides to the selection and a detail panel that expands under it.

items.name: pay-success-check
items.title: Pay Success Check
items.description: A payment success state where a ring draws, a check strokes in, dots burst outward and the amount and reference fade up.

items.name: pay-failed-retry
items.title: Pay Failed Retry
items.description: A payment failure state with a shaking x mark, an error message, reason chips and Retry and Change method buttons.

items.name: pay-slide-to-pay
items.title: Pay Slide To Pay
items.description: A slide to confirm control. The track fills as you drag, the handle turns into a check, and Enter or the arrow keys work too.

items.name: pay-order-summary
items.title: Pay Order Summary
items.description: Line items with quantity steppers, subtotal, discount, tax and total. Amounts roll when they change and the list folds on narrow containers.

items.name: pay-tip-selector
items.title: Pay Tip Selector
items.description: Tip percentage chips with the amount under each one, a custom amount field, and a total that rolls to the new value.

items.name: pay-coupon-field
items.title: Pay Coupon Field
items.description: A coupon input with Apply, loading, valid and invalid states. A valid code turns into a removable chip with the saving; an invalid one shakes.

items.name: pay-subscription-toggle
items.title: Pay Subscription Toggle
items.description: A plan card with a monthly and yearly switch. A pill slides between the two, the price rolls to the new figure and a savings badge pops in.

items.name: pay-invoice-card
items.title: Pay Invoice Card
items.description: An invoice summary with a Paid, Due or Overdue status pill, line items, download and pay buttons, and a perforated bottom edge.

items.name: pay-wallet-balance
items.title: Pay Wallet Balance
items.description: A wallet card with a counting balance, quick top-up amounts, recent activity and an eye button that blurs the figures.

items.name: login-glass-card
items.title: Login Glass Card
items.description: A frosted sign-in card floating over a slowly drifting mesh gradient and glassy orbs, with provider buttons, email and password fields, validation and a success state.

items.name: login-passkey
items.title: Login Passkey
items.description: A passkey-first sign-in with a large fingerprint that traces its ridges while a scan line sweeps, a Use passkey button with waiting and success states, and a password form that expands smoothly as a fallback.

items.name: login-social-first
items.title: Login Social First
items.description: A light sign-in page that leads with a grid of provider buttons with generic glyphs and a Last used badge, then an email and password form below a divider.

items.name: login-minimal-line
items.title: Login Minimal Line
items.description: An ultra-minimal sign-in on warm paper: a large serif greeting whose words rise in, underline fields with floating labels that draw an ink line on focus, and a pill submit button.

items.name: login-forgot-password
items.title: Login Forgot Password
items.description: A forgot password card with an animated envelope: enter an email, and it opens to show the letter, masks the address and starts a resend countdown.

items.name: login-reset-password
items.title: Login Reset Password
items.description: A new password form with a four-segment strength meter, a rules checklist that ticks off as you type, a time-to-crack estimate, confirmation matching and a success state.

items.name: login-two-factor-choice
items.title: Login Two-Factor Choice
items.description: A two-step verification screen with method radio cards for authenticator app, text message and security key, a step tracker, and a second step that shows the matching code input or key prompt.

items.name: login-account-chooser
items.title: Login Account Chooser
items.description: A choose-an-account screen with gradient avatars, workspace badges and signed-in dots, full arrow key navigation, a remembered device chip, a Use another account row and a remove mode.

items.name: login-terminal
items.title: Login Terminal
items.description: A developer sign-in told as a terminal session: prompt lines type in, a one-time device code appears with a copy button, a pulsing waiting line counts down to expiry, plus a token form for headless machines.

items.name: login-onboarding-profile
items.title: Login Onboarding Profile
items.description: A first-run profile setup in three steps with a progress bar: gradient avatar picker and name, a role chip, interest chips with a minimum, a live profile preview and a confetti finish.

items.name: card-glare
items.title: Card Glare
items.description: A poster card that tilts slightly toward the pointer while a specular band and a lit edge slide across its surface.

items.name: card-profile-holo
items.title: Profile Holo
items.description: A profile card with a foil layer whose rainbow shifts with the pointer angle, an initials avatar and a stats row.

items.name: card-pixel-hover
items.title: Pixel Hover
items.description: A canvas card whose picture breaks into a grid of pixels in a wave that starts where the pointer enters, then reforms on leave.

items.name: card-decay
items.title: Card Decay
items.description: A card whose image follows the pointer on a spring and swings with its speed, while a large title and an outlined echo trail behind it.

items.name: card-sticker-peel
items.title: Sticker Peel
items.description: A die-cut sticker on its backing sheet. Drag to peel a corner and reveal the backing, click or press Enter to peel or reset.

items.name: card-bounce-stack
items.title: Bounce Stack
items.description: A tight pile of rotated cards that fans out with an overshooting bounce on hover or focus and settles back on leave.

items.name: card-chroma-grid
items.title: Chroma Grid
items.description: A grid of cards that stays grayscale except under a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, where each card lights up in its own accent.

items.name: gallery-accordion
items.title: Gallery Accordion
items.description: A row of image panels where the hovered or focused one grows wide and the rest fold into slim strips with vertical labels.

items.name: gallery-drift-wall
items.title: Drift Wall
items.description: A wall of tiles in columns that drift against the pointer at different depths, with the hovered tile lifting forward.

items.name: card-stack-drag
items.title: Stack Drag
items.description: A deck of cards where you drag or flick the top card away with momentum and it drops to the back. Arrow keys cycle too.

items.name: scroll-progress-bar
items.title: Scroll Progress Bar
items.description: A thin gradient bar pinned to the top of the page or a container, with a percentage chip that rides its head.

items.name: scroll-parallax-layers
items.title: Scroll Parallax Layers
items.description: A dusk scene built from three SVG layers (sky, hills, pines) that drift at different speeds as it crosses the viewport.

items.name: scroll-pin-steps
items.title: Scroll Pin Steps
items.description: A pinned stage that swaps its content step by step as you scroll, with clickable step dots and a progress line.

items.name: scroll-stagger-grid
items.title: Scroll Stagger Grid
items.description: A grid of tiles that fly in one after another from alternating directions as it scrolls into view, and fly back out in reverse.

items.name: scroll-zoom-reveal
items.title: Scroll Zoom Reveal
items.description: A small framed image that grows to fill the whole stage while the headline fades away. A caption fades in at the end.

items.name: scroll-horizontal-track
items.title: Scroll Horizontal Track
items.description: A pinned section where vertical scrolling slides a strip of cards sideways, with a progress rail and a card counter.

items.name: scroll-counter-ticker
items.title: Scroll Counter Ticker
items.description: A pinned section with a big odometer whose value is tied to scroll progress. Digits roll vertically and carry over like a real counter.

items.name: scroll-sticky-stack
items.title: Scroll Sticky Stack
items.description: Cards that stick to the top and pile on each other. Each card shrinks and dims a little as the next one slides over it.

items.name: image-wipe-slider
items.title: Image Wipe Slider
items.description: A slideshow where each photo takes over with a diagonal, soft-edged wipe. Includes arrows, dots, auto-advance and keyboard control.

items.name: image-mosaic-reveal
items.title: Image Mosaic Reveal
items.description: The next photo appears tile by tile in a fixed shuffled order, each tile popping in over the previous image.

items.name: image-liquid-distort
items.title: Image Liquid Distort
items.description: A photo that ripples like water through an SVG turbulence filter. The warp swells on hover and focus and spikes when the slide changes.

items.name: image-pixelate-transition
items.title: Image Pixelate Transition
items.description: A canvas transition that pixelates the current photo into coarse blocks, swaps to the next at the peak and resolves it back to sharp.

items.name: image-split-slide
items.title: Image Split Slide
items.description: The current photo splits down the middle and the two halves slide apart to uncover the next one, which settles in from a slight zoom.

items.name: image-parallax-tilt
items.title: Image Parallax Tilt
items.description: A photo that tilts in 3D toward the pointer while its background, middle and foreground layers drift at different depths, with a moving glare. It sways on its own until touched.

items.name: image-ken-burns
items.title: Image Ken Burns
items.description: A story-style slideshow with slow zoom and pan on every photo, crossfades, segmented progress bars and tap zones for previous and next.

items.name: image-gallery-expand
items.title: Image Gallery Expand
items.description: A row of narrow image strips where the hovered or focused strip widens to reveal its caption. Click or press Enter to select one.

items.name: image-stack-swipe
items.title: Image Stack Swipe
items.description: A stack of photo cards. Drag the top one away with a tilt, or use the arrow keys, to reveal the next card underneath.

items.name: image-hover-zoom-lens
items.title: Image Hover Zoom Lens
items.description: A round magnifier that follows the pointer and shows the photo enlarged. It drifts along its own path until the pointer arrives and can be moved with the arrow keys.

items.name: toggle-theme-switch
items.title: Theme Switch
items.description: A sun and moon switch. The thumb morphs between a rayed sun and a crescent while clouds drift out and stars twinkle in.

items.name: toggle-gooey
items.title: Gooey Toggle
items.description: A pill toggle whose thumb stretches like liquid as it travels, built from two blobs merged by an SVG gooey filter.

items.name: checkbox-draw
items.title: Drawn Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that pops, fills and draws its check with a stroke. It also supports an indeterminate dash for select-all patterns.

items.name: radio-card-group
items.title: Radio Card Group
items.description: Selectable cards backed by native radios. A highlight slides to the chosen card and the radio dot springs in. Arrow keys move the selection.

items.name: input-floating-label
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: A text field whose label floats up on focus or when filled, with an animated focus line and error and success states.

items.name: input-password-strength
items.title: Password Strength Input
items.description: A password field with a show and hide button, a four segment strength bar and a checklist of rules that tick as they are met.

items.name: input-tags
items.title: Tags Input
items.description: A tag field. Enter or comma adds a chip, Backspace removes the last one, and chips scale in and out. Supports a maximum count.

items.name: slider-range-dual
items.title: Dual Range Slider
items.description: A two thumb range slider with a filled track, value bubbles, a minimum gap, pointer dragging and full keyboard control.

items.name: stepper-number
items.title: Number Stepper
items.description: A quantity stepper with plus and minus buttons, digits that roll like an odometer and hold to repeat with acceleration.

items.name: select-command
items.title: Command Select
items.description: A searchable select. Type to filter with highlighted matches, move with the arrow keys, group options and close with Escape.

items.name: otp-input-inline
items.title: Inline Code Input
items.description: A compact one line code field built on a single real input, with a blinking caret, pop-in characters and full paste support.

items.name: cursor-target
items.title: Cursor Target
items.description: A lock-on reticle with four corner brackets and a rotating dashed ring. It follows the pointer and shrinks onto buttons and links when you hover or tab to them.

items.name: cursor-ghost
items.title: Cursor Ghost
items.description: A faint ghost that trails the pointer on a spring, leans into its motion, looks where it is going and leaves a fading afterimage.

items.name: cursor-swarm
items.title: Cursor Swarm
items.description: A flock of small arrow points that steer toward the pointer, keep their distance from each other and circle it like starlings.

items.name: cursor-fluid-splash
items.title: Cursor Fluid Splash
items.description: Colorful blobs pour out along the pointer path, carry its velocity, swirl in a soft flow field and fade into streaks.

items.name: cursor-ribbons
items.title: Cursor Ribbons
items.description: Several glowing ribbons chase the pointer through spring-chained segments, taper to a point and blend where they cross.

items.name: cursor-metaballs
items.title: Cursor Metaballs
items.description: A gooey blob follows the pointer while smaller blobs orbit it, stretch away and melt back in through an SVG goo filter.

items.name: cursor-pixel-trail
items.title: Cursor Pixel Trail
items.description: Cells on a pixel grid light up under the pointer and fade out in hard steps, like an old LED matrix.

items.name: cursor-image-trail
items.title: Cursor Image Trail
items.description: Small photo tiles drop along the pointer path every few dozen pixels, then tilt, drift away and fade.

items.name: cursor-crosshair
items.title: Cursor Crosshair
items.description: Full-width dashed guide lines follow the pointer with X and Y readout chips and a dot that snaps to a grid, like a design tool ruler.

items.name: cursor-glare-grid
items.title: Cursor Glare Grid
items.description: A field of tiny needles turns to face the pointer like compasses, growing and lighting up the closer they are.

items.name: text-pressure
items.title: Text Pressure
items.description: Every letter swells in weight and size as the pointer gets close, with a slow breathing wave when nothing is touching it.

items.name: text-scramble-hover
items.title: Text Scramble Hover
items.description: Letters near the pointer flip to random glyphs and settle back one by one once it moves away.

items.name: text-warp
items.title: Text Warp
items.description: A lens follows the pointer and bends the line: letters shove aside, grow and tilt with a smooth falloff.

items.name: text-fuzzy
items.title: Text Fuzzy
items.description: Text with a flickering noise displacement, like a worn signal, that grows rougher while hovered or focused.

items.name: text-mask-reveal
items.title: Text Mask Reveal
items.description: Lines or words slide up out of an invisible mask with a stagger when the block scrolls into view.

items.name: text-highlight-marker
items.title: Text Highlight Marker
items.description: Chosen words get a hand-drawn marker stroke that sweeps across them one after another.

items.name: text-underline-draw
items.title: Text Underline Draw
items.description: A wavy or straight underline that draws itself under the text on hover, focus or when it scrolls into view.

items.name: text-odometer
items.title: Text Odometer
items.description: Each digit rolls vertically to its new value like a mechanical counter, with separators and symbols left in place.

items.name: text-flip-words
items.title: Text Flip Words
items.description: A sentence with one slot that flips through a list of words in 3D while the line resizes to fit each one.

items.name: text-fill-scroll
items.title: Text Fill Scroll
items.description: A paragraph that fills with color word by word, left to right, as it scrolls through the viewport.

items.name: text-3d-extrude
items.title: Text 3D Extrude
items.description: Text built from a stack of shifted layers that forms a solid extrusion and tilts with the pointer.

items.name: text-liquid-gradient
items.title: Text Liquid Gradient
items.description: Text filled with soft color blobs that drift through each other, over a blurred glow of the same colors.

items.name: bg-grid-distortion
items.title: Grid Distortion
items.description: A fine line grid that bulges around the pointer like a magnifying lens, with a soft accent glow where it bends. Drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

items.name: bg-magnet-lines
items.title: Magnet Lines
items.description: A field of short strokes that turn to face the pointer like iron filings around a magnet. Without a pointer they follow a slow swirl.

items.name: bg-dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.description: A dense grid of dots that swell and scatter away from the pointer, then spring back into place with a little overshoot.

items.name: bg-ripple-water
items.title: Ripple Water
items.description: A dark water surface where the pointer leaves trails of wavy rings and a click drops a stone. Raindrops fall on their own while nobody is touching it.

items.name: bg-liquid-ether
items.title: Liquid Ether
items.description: Soft pastel clouds that drift on a slow current and get swept along by the speed and direction of the pointer, leaving a colored wake.

items.name: bg-topography
items.title: Topography
items.description: Contour lines of a slowly shifting terrain, like a living survey map. The pointer raises a hill that pulls the lines into rings around it.

items.name: bg-light-tunnel
items.title: Light Tunnel
items.description: Glowing rounded frames fly out of the distance in an endless tunnel. The vanishing point leans toward the pointer.

items.name: bg-glitch-letters
items.title: Glitch Letters
items.description: A wall of monospaced characters that keep flickering into new glyphs and colors, with short glitch bursts along a row. Letters brighten around the pointer.

items.name: button-spotlight
items.title: Button Spotlight
items.description: A soft light follows the pointer across the face while the border brightens near the cursor. It drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

items.name: button-slide-fill
items.title: Button Slide Fill
items.description: Color fills from the side the pointer enters and drains out through the side it leaves, with the label color inverting in sync.

items.name: button-glitch-hover
items.title: Button Glitch Hover
items.description: Chromatic slices of the label jitter on hover and keyboard focus, then snap clean when the pointer leaves. A brief glitch also fires now and then while idle.

items.name: button-3d-press
items.title: Button 3D Press
items.description: A chunky tactile button with a solid depth edge. It squashes flat on press and springs back with overshoot.

items.name: button-neon-pulse
items.title: Button Neon Pulse
items.description: A neon outline with a breathing glow that quickens on hover. Each click sends a ring ripple out from the pointer.

items.name: button-arrow-reveal
items.title: Button Arrow Reveal
items.description: On hover the label slides left while an arrow slides in beside it. Clicking loops the arrow out the right edge and back in.

items.name: button-stateful
items.title: Button Stateful
items.description: Morphs from idle to loading to success and back. The width animates to fit each label and the check draws itself. Driven by a promise returned from onClick or by a status prop.

items.name: button-copy
items.title: Button Copy
items.description: Copies a string to the clipboard. The icon morphs into a check and the label swaps from Copy to Copied, then reverts after 1.6 seconds.

items.name: button-download-progress
items.title: Button Download Progress
items.description: Click starts a simulated download. A fill bar and percentage run inside the button and it ends on Done with a drawn check.

items.name: button-stacked-text
items.title: Button Stacked Text
items.description: The label is stacked above an alternate label. Hover rolls the letters upward one by one to reveal the second line.

items.name: loader-orbit
items.title: Loader Orbit
items.description: Three glowing dots travel around concentric rings at different radii and speeds, with a beating core in the middle.

items.name: loader-wave-dots
items.title: Loader Wave Dots
items.description: A row of dots rides a sine wave while a color sweep runs through them from the first dot to the last.

items.name: loader-equalizer
items.title: Loader Equalizer
items.description: Audio-style bars bounce out of phase with their own rhythm. Good for buffering, streaming and listening states.

items.name: loader-ring-gradient
items.title: Loader Ring Gradient
items.description: A conic gradient ring with a glowing head that spins while the whole ring breathes in and out.

items.name: loader-progress-stripes
items.title: Loader Progress Stripes
items.description: A determinate progress bar with moving stripes, a soft glint at the leading edge and a tabular percentage.

items.name: loader-percentage
items.title: Loader Percentage
items.description: A large percentage counter inside an SVG ring that fills as it counts. Pass a value, or leave it out to run a looping demo.

items.name: loader-morph-shapes
items.title: Loader Morph Shapes
items.description: A single gradient shape morphs from a circle to a rounded square to a triangle and back, turning as it goes.

items.name: loader-typing
items.title: Loader Typing
items.description: A chat typing indicator with three hopping dots in a bubble, plus an optional avatar and sender name.

items.name: loader-radar
items.title: Loader Radar
items.description: A radar sweep rotates over concentric rings and lights up blips as it passes over them, at the same positions every time.

items.name: loader-pulse-rings
items.title: Loader Pulse Rings
items.description: Concentric rings expand from a core icon and fade out, staggered so there is always a pulse in flight.

items.name: loader-cube
items.title: Loader Cube
items.description: A translucent CSS 3D cube turns on its vertical axis above a soft shadow that breathes with the rotation.

items.name: loader-text-scramble
items.title: Loader Text Scramble
items.description: A word scrambles through random glyphs and resolves letter by letter, holds for a moment and starts over. Monospace, with a blinking cursor.

items.name: auth-split-brand
items.title: Auth Split Brand
items.description: A full-width sign-in section: a brand panel with a drifting gradient and rotating customer quotes on one side, a complete email and password form with social buttons on the other.

items.name: auth-signup-steps
items.title: Auth Signup Steps
items.description: A three-step sign-up wizard for account, workspace and team invites, with a progress rail, sliding step transitions and validation on every step.

items.name: auth-otp
items.title: Auth OTP
items.description: A verification screen with single-digit code inputs that auto-advance, accept a pasted code and step back on Backspace, plus a resend countdown, an error shake and a success check.

items.name: auth-magic-link
items.title: Auth Magic Link
items.description: A light passwordless sign-in: an email field that morphs into a Check your inbox state with an envelope that folds shut, a resend countdown and a change email action.

items.name: contact-split-form
items.title: Contact Split Form
items.description: A two-column contact section: email, live chat and office hours cards on the left, a validated form with a topic select and a character counter inside a rotating border beam on the right.

items.name: contact-offices
items.title: Contact Offices
items.description: Global offices on a dotted world map with pulsing city markers and arcs from headquarters. Hovering or focusing a city opens its address card, synced with a list showing each office's local time.

items.name: contact-support-cards
items.title: Contact Support Cards
items.description: Three support channel cards for docs, priority support and community with response-time chips and a pointer tilt, followed by a minimal inline question field.

items.name: contact-minimal-light
items.title: Contact Minimal Light
items.description: A light editorial contact section with a huge serif Let's talk headline, a fill-in-the-blanks sentence form with suggestion chips, and studio details on the side.

items.name: how-steps-line
items.title: How It Works: Steps Line
items.description: Four numbered step cards joined by a line that fills from start to end when the section scrolls into view. Each card carries a small looping illustration.

items.name: how-sticky-scroll
items.title: How It Works: Sticky Scroll
items.description: Step descriptions on the left and a sticky product mockup on the right that switches screens as each step reaches the middle of the viewport. Steps are also clickable.

items.name: how-timeline-vertical
items.title: How It Works: Vertical Timeline
items.description: A light, editorial timeline with serif titles and cards that alternate sides. The line fills and the current dot pulses as you scroll; on narrow screens every card sits on the right.

items.name: how-flow-diagram
items.title: How It Works: Flow Diagram
items.description: Four connected nodes for input, process, review and output, with packets traveling along the paths, a skip route and a loop back. Hovering or focusing a node shows its details below.

items.name: download-platforms
items.title: Download: Platforms
items.description: Desktop download cards for macOS, Windows and Linux. The card matching the platform prop gets a rotating beam border and the primary button, and every card has a checksum you can copy.

items.name: download-app-badges
items.title: Download: App Badges
items.description: A mobile app promo with a phone mockup, floating cards that drift, generic store badges, a scannable-looking QR pattern and a rating line.

items.name: download-install-tabs
items.title: Download: Install Tabs
