items.description: A light developer install block with tabs for npm, pnpm, yarn and brew. The command types itself out on every switch and each box has a copy button with a copied state.

items.name: waitlist-counter
items.title: Waitlist: Live Counter
items.description: A light, centered waitlist with an email field, a rolling counter that ticks up live and on signup, an avatar stack and a road-to-launch bar. After signup it shows the spot number and a referral link to copy.

items.name: waitlist-launch-card
items.title: Waitlist: Launch Card
items.description: A dark glass card over drifting color with a four-tile flip countdown to a launch date, an email form and a perks column.

items.name: bento-product
items.title: Bento Product
items.description: An asymmetric four-column bento with a revenue chart that switches range, a sprint calendar, working automation toggles, live presence and a typing command bar.

items.name: bento-metrics
items.title: Bento Metrics
items.description: A dashboard-style bento with counting stat tiles, a plan donut, a sparkline strip, goal progress bars, an NPS gauge and a 30-day uptime bar.

items.name: bento-integrations
items.title: Bento Integrations
items.description: An integrations bento with a central hub, animated data flowing along curved links, connectable service tiles, a scrolling webhook log and an SDK install snippet.

items.name: bento-terminal
items.title: Bento Terminal
items.description: A developer bento with a terminal that types a deploy command, a code diff, a rollout status card, a git graph and a per-region latency heat strip.

items.name: bento-editorial
items.title: Bento Editorial
items.description: A light, magazine-style bento on paper with serif headlines, grainy gradient covers, a pull quote, a big numeral and a selectable tag cloud.

items.name: bento-spotlight
items.title: Bento Spotlight
items.description: A 3x3 feature grid where the hovered or focused tile lifts under a pointer-following glow while the others dim and blur, each tile with its own animated icon.

items.name: showcase-browser
items.title: Showcase Browser
items.description: A product showcase with copy on the left and a browser frame on a gradient stage whose page scrolls slowly, with floating callouts pointing at what matters.

items.name: showcase-device-stack
items.title: Showcase Device Stack
items.description: A laptop, tablet and phone stacked in depth that tilt with parallax as the pointer moves, above a four-column feature caption row.

items.name: showcase-marquee-cards
items.title: Showcase Marquee Cards
items.description: A light portfolio section with two rows of project cards gliding in opposite directions, faded at the edges and paused on hover or focus.

items.name: blog-featured-grid
items.title: Blog Featured Grid
items.description: A blog index section with one large featured story beside a two by two grid of recent posts, gradient covers, category chips and author initials.

items.name: blog-list-editorial
items.title: Blog List Editorial
items.description: A light, paper toned list of essays with a date column, serif titles, excerpts and a sticky category filter that fades the list in on change.

items.name: blog-article-header
items.title: Blog Article Header
items.description: The top of a single article: breadcrumb, large title that blurs in word by word, author block, share buttons, a reading progress bar and an opening paragraph with a drop cap.

items.name: blog-carousel
items.title: Blog Carousel
items.description: A horizontal row of post cards with native scroll snapping, previous and next buttons, a position counter, a progress meter and fading edges.

items.name: shop-product-detail
items.title: Shop Product Detail
items.description: A product page section with a switchable gallery and hover zoom, rating, price with savings, color swatches, size chips, a quantity stepper and an add to bag button that morphs into a confirmation.

items.name: shop-cart-summary
items.title: Shop Cart Summary
items.description: A cart panel with line items, quantity steppers and remove, a free shipping progress bar, a promo code field with valid and invalid states and totals that count to their new value.

items.name: shop-collection-hero
items.title: Shop Collection Hero
items.description: A light collection page opener: a warm banner with a serif title and floating product art, filter chips and a row of four products with wishlist hearts and a quick add overlay.

items.name: shop-checkout-steps
items.title: Shop Checkout Steps
items.description: A three step checkout with an animated step header, a shipping form, delivery method cards with prices, payment options, a review screen and a live order summary.

items.name: pricing-switch
items.title: Pricing Switch
items.description: Three tiers in one joined panel with a sliding monthly and yearly switch. Prices roll like an odometer when the period changes and the featured tier glows with a rotating border.

items.name: pricing-slider
items.title: Pricing Slider
items.description: Usage-based pricing driven by a keyboard-friendly range slider. The estimate, graduated tier breakdown and cost bar update live, with tier thresholds marked on the track.

items.name: pricing-compare-cards
items.title: Pricing Compare Cards
items.description: A light paper layout with two large plan cards whose feature rows tick, dash or show a value side by side, and a dark enterprise strip underneath.

items.name: pricing-credits
items.title: Pricing Credits
items.description: Credit pack pricing with four selectable cards that tilt toward the pointer, a best value ribbon, per-credit prices and savings, a purchase bar and a three-line FAQ strip.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: A feature matrix with grouped rows, a sticky header and a glowing highlighted column. Rows highlight on hover and the table turns into stacked cards in narrow containers.

items.name: comparison-versus
items.title: Comparison Versus
items.description: A Before and After split with a spinning VS badge between two contrasting panels, and a metric strip whose bars grow to show the change.

items.name: comparison-slider
items.title: Comparison Slider
items.description: A light section with a draggable divider over two release timelines. Drag or use the arrow keys to reveal how the same stages shrink from weeks to days.

items.name: cta-gradient-card
items.title: CTA Gradient Card
items.description: A large rounded card with a flowing gradient border, floating shapes, a gradient headline and an inline email form with a success state.

items.name: cta-marquee-band
items.title: CTA Marquee Band
items.description: A full-bleed band where the call to action loops in three huge marquee rows, solid, outlined and dim, behind a pill button that magnetically follows the pointer.

items.name: cta-split-light
items.title: CTA Split Light
items.description: A light paper split with a serif headline whose key word gets a hand-drawn underline, bullet promises, a compact signup card and a row of trust logos.

items.name: nav-mega-menu
items.title: Nav Mega Menu
items.description: A top bar whose triggers open a wide mega menu with three columns of icon links, a featured card and a footer strip. Opens on hover with an intent delay and is fully keyboard driven.

items.name: nav-floating-island
items.title: Nav Floating Island
items.description: A centered floating pill nav with a springy highlight that slides between links, a search chip with a Cmd K shortcut and an account menu. It shrinks into a compact island when compact is set or the page scrolls.

items.name: nav-sidebar-mobile
items.title: Nav Sidebar Mobile
items.description: A mobile app bar whose animated hamburger opens a full-height drawer with grouped links, accordion sub-links, a search field and an account footer. Focus is trapped while open and Escape closes it.

items.name: nav-announce-split
items.title: Nav Announce Split
items.description: A light header with a dismissible announcement strip, the logo on the left, centered links with a drawing underline, log in and a call to action on the right, and a hairline that fills as the page scrolls.

items.name: footer-mega
items.title: Footer Mega
items.description: A large footer with a newsletter card, a brand column with social buttons, five link columns, and a bottom row with legal links, a live status pill and a language selector.

items.name: footer-giant-wordmark
items.title: Footer Giant Wordmark
items.description: A minimal footer with a statement, an email link and a compact link row, ending in an enormous wordmark that spans the full width, fades out at the bottom and rises letter by letter when it scrolls into view.

items.name: footer-cta-sitemap
items.title: Footer CTA Sitemap
items.description: A light paper footer that opens with a deep green call to action card, with serif headline and orbiting rating seal, overlapping into a sitemap with serif column titles, an address block and a legal row.

items.name: footer-links-rail
items.title: Footer Links Rail
items.description: A compact single row footer: brand, copyright, link groups as pill menus and a back to top button whose arrow launches up and drops back in. It wraps into stacked rows on small screens.

items.name: features-grid-glow
items.title: Features Grid Glow
items.description: A six-card feature grid under a split header. One soft spotlight follows the pointer across every card at once, lighting borders and surfaces, and cards lift on hover.

items.name: features-alternating
items.title: Features Alternating
items.description: Numbered feature rows that alternate copy and visual sides. Each visual is a small animated product screen (an inbox, a routing flow, a chart) that plays when its row scrolls into view.

items.name: features-tabs
items.title: Features Tabs
items.description: A vertical tab list with a progress bar that advances to the next feature every few seconds, beside a window that crossfades between product mockups. Hover pauses it and arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: features-checklist
items.title: Features Checklist
items.description: A light paper section with a large serif headline, a two-column ticklist whose check marks draw in one after another, and a pinned summary card that stays in view while the list scrolls.

items.name: features-orbit
items.title: Features Orbit
items.description: A central product mark with feature chips circling it on two counter-rotating rings. Hovering a chip pauses the orbit and slides out its label, and a row of captions sits beneath.

items.name: stats-counters
items.title: Stats Counters
items.description: Four oversized numbers that count up when the row scrolls into view, separated by hairlines, each with a label, a sparkline that draws itself and a small change note.

items.name: stats-bar-race
items.title: Stats Bar Race
items.description: A headline and summary figure beside a ranked bar chart. On view the bars race out to their values, larger ones running longer, while the numbers count up in step.

items.name: stats-radial
items.title: Stats Radial
items.description: A light section with three radial progress rings that sweep in on view, with tick marks that light up behind the arc, counting center numbers and a short description under each.

items.name: stats-ticker
items.title: Stats Ticker
items.description: A dark full-bleed band with one oversized featured figure on top and two rows of metrics scrolling in opposite directions underneath, each with a value and a colored change arrow.

items.name: notfound-glitch
items.title: 404 Glitch
items.description: A split 404 page with a giant code torn by chromatic glitch slices, a scanline sweep and a terminal log that types out the failed request.

items.name: notfound-astronaut
items.title: 404 Astronaut
items.description: A lost in space 404 page with an illustrated astronaut that floats and slowly spins over an outlined code, twinkling stars, a glowing planet horizon and pointer parallax.

items.name: notfound-search
items.title: 404 Search
items.description: A light 404 page with a serif headline, a live search that filters popular pages as you type, keyboard navigation and a hand-drawn arrow that draws itself in.

items.name: notfound-broken-plug
items.title: 404 Broken Plug
items.description: A 404 page with a flickering neon code and an unplugged cable whose plug and socket throw sparks. The retry button plugs it back in with a short reconnect animation.

items.name: profile-header-card
items.title: Profile Header Card
items.description: A social profile header with a drifting gradient cover, overlapping avatar, follow and message actions, stats that count up and tabs with a sliding underline.

items.name: profile-creator-bio
items.title: Profile Creator Bio
items.description: A light link-in-bio section with a spinning gradient avatar ring, availability status, pill links that fill and slide on hover, a shining featured link and a row of social icons.

items.name: profile-dev-card
items.title: Profile Dev Card
items.description: A developer profile with avatar, role, location, stack chips, a year of contributions as an animated heatmap with hover tooltips, and pinned project cards with stars and forks.

items.name: proof-wall
items.title: Proof Wall
items.description: A masonry wall of testimonial cards in three columns. The outer columns drift slowly in opposite directions under soft top and bottom fades, and pause on hover.

items.name: proof-spotlight-quote
items.title: Proof Spotlight Quote
items.description: One large serif quote at a time on a paper background. It advances every few seconds with a blur crossfade, and small avatar buttons with a progress ring let visitors pick a quote.

items.name: proof-logo-cloud
items.title: Proof Logo Cloud
items.description: A hairline grid of twelve wordmark tiles that go from gray to full color on hover, with a light sweep that travels across the grid and a star rating line below.

items.name: proof-metrics-quotes
items.title: Proof Metrics Quotes
items.description: Three result cards, each with a big number that counts up when the section scrolls into view, a growing bar, a short quote and the customer behind it.

items.name: faq-search
items.title: FAQ Search
items.description: A search field that filters questions as you type and highlights every match, popular keyword chips, a smooth accordion and a friendly empty state with a contact button.

items.name: faq-two-column
items.title: FAQ Two Column
items.description: A light FAQ with a sticky left column holding the title and a support card with online status, and numbered questions on the right that open with a smooth height animation.

items.name: faq-categories
items.title: FAQ Categories
items.description: Category tabs with a sliding pill switch between sets of question cards, which slide and fade in from the direction you moved. Arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: about-story
items.title: About Story
items.description: A company story with a large serif statement, a row of key facts, a five-step timeline whose line draws down as it enters view, and a founder note card.

items.name: about-values
items.title: About Values
items.description: A light values section with six numbered cards, a softly bobbing row of team avatars with a head count, and a strip of open roles as pill links.

items.name: hero-editorial
items.title: Hero Editorial
items.description: A light, magazine-style hero on warm paper: a large serif headline with an italic word that gets a hand-drawn underline, a floating collage of paper cards and a slow marquee of press names.

items.name: hero-orbs
items.title: Hero Orbs
items.description: A dark waitlist hero: three blurred gradient orbs drift on slow orbits behind a frosted glass card with the headline, a validated email form with a success state, and a row of avatars.

items.name: hero-prompt
items.title: Hero Prompt
items.description: A centered hero built around a large prompt box: auto-growing textarea, Enter to send, a rotating placeholder, suggestion chips that type themselves in and a glow that pulses while the box is focused.

items.name: hero-spotlight
items.title: Hero Spotlight
items.description: A dark hero where a soft spotlight follows the pointer, revealing a hidden dotted grid, floating metric chips and a brighter copy of the headline. It drifts on its own path when nobody is pointing.

items.name: hero-particles
items.title: Hero Particles
items.description: A constellation hero: drifting points linked by proximity lines that lean toward the pointer, behind a centered headline with a shimmering gradient phrase and a copyable install command.

items.name: hero-beams
items.title: Hero Beams
items.description: Vertical light beams fall and fade toward a glowing horizon arc, under a headline that splits into red and cyan on hover. Three stats count up when the hero scrolls into view.

items.name: hero-aurora
items.title: Hero Aurora
items.description: A dark, centered hero with drifting aurora ribbons, a shining pill badge and a headline that sharpens in word by word over a fading grid.

items.name: hero-grid
items.title: Hero Grid
items.description: A technical hero with a perspective grid floor running toward a glowing horizon, a headline that decodes into place and a copyable install command.

items.name: hero-product
items.title: Hero Product
items.description: A split hero with copy on the left and a layered product mockup on the right that floats gently and tilts in depth with the pointer, above a row of customer logos.

items.name: hero-type
items.title: Hero Type
items.description: A typographic hero in bone on black with a giant tight headline, a rotating italic word, oversized numerals and a two-row keyword marquee.
